segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The ED note said he ambulates independently with a cane and lives alone. That's a pretty common profile for us, so I had a sense of where this was probably headed.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: An initial baseline is expressed, but this span alone does not establish failure to update.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Within that conversation I felt like I had a good read on him... my instinct said steady.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant expresses high confidence in a rapid mobility read before formal PT data.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I had already sort of built my plan around the independent-living picture, so those things registered more as things to keep an eye on rather than something that should make me start over.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The original independent-living description remains the reference point despite contradictory PT and nursing data.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: From that, plus the fact he'd gone home successfully after two previous admissions, I moved forward planning for home with outpatient services.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A provisional plan is expressed without the explicit expectation-based interpretation required for eb_01.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I was asking more 'how do we make this work' than 'can this actually work.'
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Follow-up questions favored implementing the home plan rather than testing caregiver adequacy.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Families usually do step up... So I took her willingness at face value as enough to build around.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A vague caregiver statement is interpreted as sufficient because similar families usually work out.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: It did mean the coverage picture was thinner than what I'd been planning around.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a non-biased acknowledgment of newly discovered coverage limits.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: That case was still fresh, and honestly it's the first thing that came to mind when I was thinking through Hoffmann's risk.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A vivid recent case shapes risk estimation before review of the patient's own data.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Leaving the tool for later felt like the lower-stakes choice.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Omission of the available risk tool is treated as less consequential than active reassessment.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The numbers didn't fully back up how worried I'd been feeling based on that other case.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is retrospective recognition of an objective-data mismatch, not a separate instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: There was a short-term rehab bed available... The alternative was finalizing home discharge that same day.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Options and constraints are described without the hidden affective-forecasting mechanism.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The frustration and the sense of being stuck here would carry over past the delay itself. So finishing the extra checks felt like it would cost more than it was worth.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant forecasts an extended distress reaction and uses it to reject completing verification.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: He was distressed even talking about waiting a day, and I didn't want to put him through that.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Patient distress is a legitimate consideration here; overestimation is not independently established in this span.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: If I'd pushed harder on specifics with the daughter earlier instead of assuming it would work out, we might have caught the coverage gap sooner.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a retrospective process reflection, not a new occurrence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Run the risk tool earlier, and ask more direct questions about caregiving capacity.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Corrective intentions are not separately scored as bias occurrences.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: The finding is correctly localized and mechanistically complete, but search satisficing is not an approved equivalent label for Confirmation Bias.
The finding captures Impact Bias's affective-forecasting mechanism but uses the distinct label affect heuristic.
The candidate has a full Expectation Bias mechanism and exact localization, but optimism bias is not an approved equivalent label; it becomes a mechanism-first candidate-tier true positive.
The quote is valid and localized, but the candidate proposes confirmation bias for a segment whose hidden mechanism is anchoring; the stated mechanism does not fully match.

candidates.details: The candidate preserves uncertainty appropriately while stating the full expectation-based mechanism; it recovers the hidden instance only under mechanism-first scoring.
The candidate is supported by the quote but duplicates neither the hidden anchoring label nor its defining mechanism.

high_only.detection_interpretation: High-confidence findings detect anchoring, confirmation-search, and availability segments, but miss overconfidence, expectation, omission, and impact segments.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: Adding moderate-confidence findings recovers omission and impact segments without introducing segment-level false alarms.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: No low-confidence identified findings were present, so this tier equals high_and_moderate.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: Candidate inclusion recovers the expectation segment while retaining zero segment-level false alarms.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: Full selective-search mechanism overlap, but the label is not an approved equivalent.
Full affective-forecasting overlap, but affect heuristic is distinct from Impact Bias.
Full expectation-based interpretation mechanism; strict label equivalence is not established.
The candidate is localized correctly but describes confirmation-style interpretation rather than anchoring and adjustment.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: Three identified occurrences claim retrieved corpus support, but no retrieved passages or logs were supplied and their source identifiers are null; two identified occurrences explicitly disclose unavailable support.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Adding moderate findings recovers omission and impact detections, increasing segment F1 from 0.6000 to 0.8333 and mechanism-first instance F1 from 0.6000 to 0.8333.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: No change; no low-confidence identified findings were present.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: Candidate inclusion recovers expectation under mechanism-first scoring but adds one candidate false positive and lowers strict instance F1 from 0.5000 to 0.4286.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At high_and_moderate, 5 of 7 positive segments were detected with 0 false alarms and segment F1 0.8333.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: At high_and_moderate, strict scoring produced 3 true positives, 4 false negatives, 2 false positives, and F1 0.5000.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: At high_and_moderate, mechanism-first scoring produced 5 true positives, 2 false negatives, 0 false positives, and F1 0.8333.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: One candidate recovered the hidden expectation mechanism only under mechanism-first scoring; the other was a supported but nonmatching near miss.
main_failure_modes: The overconfidence instance was missed entirely.
Confirmation and impact mechanisms were detected under near-neighbor labels rather than hidden target labels.
Expectation was retained only as a candidate.
Candidate inclusion introduced one strict false positive.
main_strengths: Anchoring, availability, and omission were correctly identified and localized.
All cited interview quotations were valid and substantively supportive.
The analysis disclosed uncertainty and unavailable support for the weaker labels.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: The run has strong segment detection and mechanism-level performance, but materially weaker strict ontology-label performance because two identified findings and one candidate used near-neighbor labels.
